actions.description:
Requirements Volodmyra successfully Strikes a second enemy when making a sweep attack with her axe and is within 10 feet of a third enemy she hasn't yet attacked

Effect Volodmyra spins in a circle (Stepping 5 feet if she chooses) and makes a third attack against a foe she hasn't attacked this round. This third attack suffers only a -8 penalty to the attack roll (instead of the standard -10 on a third Strike). If it hits, Volodmyra deals an additional 2d6 points of damage from the furious impact.
actions.name: Spinning Sweep
actions.requirements: Volodmyra successfully Strikes a second enemy when making a sweep attack with her axe and is within 10 feet of a third enemy she hasn't yet attacked

actions.description:
Requirements Volodmyra is wielding her greataxe and is adjacent to an enemy

Effect Volodmyra raises her greataxe above her head and puts all of her might into a single attack. If the attack hits, Volodmyra deals an additional 8 points of damage and the opponent must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:17] save to avoid being knocked Prone.
actions.name: Overhand Smash
actions.requirements: Volodmyra is wielding her greataxe and is adjacent to an enemy
